name: blackgit
description: Agent skills for BlackGit, the sparse/promisor git client for monorepos: follow cared files, fast-forward update, tree listing, file locks

interface.longDescription: Use BlackGit skills to clone huge monorepos (multi-GB binaries, game assets) with partial clone, materialize only the files you follow, fast-forward updates without downloading blobs, list remote trees without checking out, and lock files against concurrent pushes.
